title: Best Resume Designers (2026): Clean CVs That Pass ATS
description: How to hire a resume designer: ATS-friendly layouts, editable files, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: A resume designer turns your career details into a clean, easy-to-scan layout. Good design helps a recruiter find what matters in seconds. Problems start when a beautiful resume cannot be read by applicant tracking systems (ATS), you cannot edit the file later, or the design distracts from the content. This guide helps you get a resume that looks good and still works in real hiring systems.

faq.q: Will a designed resume pass ATS?
faq.a: It can, if the layout is simple: real text, standard headings and no important information inside images or complex tables. Ask the designer to confirm the file is ATS-friendly.

faq.q: Does the designer write the content?
faq.a: Usually not. Resume design arranges the content you supply. If you also need the wording improved, hire a resume writer or a package that includes writing.

faq.q: Which file formats should I get?
faq.a: A PDF for sending and an editable file, such as Word or Google Docs, so you can update it yourself.

faq.q: Should I use photos, icons and colors?
faq.a: It depends on your country and industry. Many employers prefer simple resumes without photos. Keep color and icons subtle.

faq.q: Can I get a matching cover letter?
faq.a: Many designers offer a matching cover letter template and LinkedIn banner. Ask if you want a consistent set.
